name: REPORT-FTG_Web Filter: Access to AI Category
description: The FortiGate web filter detected user access to websites categorized under Artificial Intelligence Technology. Although the access was not blocked, monitoring this type of access may be important in environments where usage of generative AI tools or AI-related platforms is restricted or requires approval. This alert may support compliance, data governance, or intellectual property protection efforts.
alert_name: FTG_Web Filter: Access to AI Category
alert_description: The FortiGate web filter detected user access to websites categorized under Artificial Intelligence Technology. Although the access was not blocked, monitoring this type of access may be important in environments where usage of generative AI tools or AI-related platforms is restricted or requires approval. This alert may support compliance, data governance, or intellectual property protection efforts.
investigation_query_link:
dataset = fortinet_fortigate_raw
| filter cat = "utm:webfilter"
  and act != "blocked"
  and (
    requestContext = "Malicious Websites" or
    requestContext = "Phishing" or
    requestContext = "Spam URLs" or
    requestContext = "Dynamic DNS" or
    requestContext = "Peer-to-peer File Sharing" or
    requestContext = "Crypto Mining"
  )
| alter
    timestamp = _time,
    src_ip = src,
    dst_ip = dst,

    category = requestContext,
    action_taken = act,
    application = app,
    log_message = msg,
    request_origin = dhost,
    user = duser,
    device_name = _reporting_device_name
| fields timestamp, device_name, src_ip, dst_ip, category, application, action_taken, log_message, request_origin, user
